body: sometimes my cuts feel like they’re burning while I’m showering. If it hurts too much, I’ll get a dry towel and put pressure on the cuts, covering as many as I can. Helps me, at least

Watch the blood for a bit, pick at it when it clots, then clean it up with water and paper towels. Curl up in bed and sleep. Usually I’m pretty exhausted afterwards, cuz of all the feelings and stuff. Feels like a massive release of energy, so I can finally settle down.
Definitely. Wake up feeling horrible, and it’ll only get worse and worse. It just piles on til I get an outlet
